description.zh: 产品决定要比较事实与假设，Agent 编排要约定工具边界，图像制作则需要视觉简报。准备 OpenAI 任务时，应将这些输入和审阅条件分别对应到实际可用的模型或绘图入口。
description.en: Product decisions, agent orchestration, and image production need different inputs and review criteria. Compare project constraints with visual briefs and tool permissions, then match each task to its actual OpenAI model or drawing entry point.

A difficult product decision often contains conflicting requirements and constraints that cannot all be relaxed. Compare candidate options against explicit criteria, separating facts from assumptions and choices requiring confirmation. The decision brief should give the team a reasoned direction and a clear list of unresolved questions.
description.zh: 复杂产品决定往往包含相互冲突的要求，以及无法随意放宽的约束。按照明确标准比较候选方案，分别说明事实、假设和需要确认的选择。决策简报应让团队理解建议方向的依据，并看清仍未解决的问题。

description.en: Agent orchestration needs a multistep objective, available tools, dependencies, and approval rules. Map instruction priority and tool results to the actions that may follow, with verification at each stage. Describe inputs, outputs, and failure handling so the plan can be reviewed before execution begins.
description.zh: 设计 Agent 编排时，先提供多步骤目标、可用工具、依赖关系和授权规则。梳理指令优先级及工具结果如何影响后续行动，并为各阶段保留验证节点。执行方案应说明输入、输出和失败处理，方便在开始前审阅整个流程。

title.zh: 根据创意简报生成图像

description.en: Image work begins with intended use, visual content, dimensions, supplied brand assets, and revision requirements. Choose the appropriate drawing workflow, compare previews against the brief, and revise the mismatches. Deliver the visual assets with concrete revision notes rather than treating the first generated image as the final result.
description.zh: 图像任务需要说明用途、画面内容、尺寸、已有品牌素材和修改要求。使用适合的绘图流程生成预览，对照简报检查差异，再进行针对性调整。交付视觉素材时保留具体修改意见，不把首次生成的图片直接当作最终成果。

title.en: Design recovery after a tool failure
title.zh: 设计工具失败后的恢复流程

description.en: A multistep agent task needs a clear response when a tool returns an error or incomplete evidence. Supply the intended action, observed result, and approval rules, then compare retry, investigation, and stop conditions. The recovery plan should preserve task state and human decisions instead of allowing an unsuccessful call to trigger an unbounded sequence of actions.
description.zh: 多步骤 Agent 任务需要明确处理工具错误或证据不完整的情况。提供预期动作、实际返回和批准规则，比较重试、继续调查及停止条件。恢复方案保留任务状态和人工决定，避免一次失败调用引发没有边界的后续行动。

title.en: One provider family, accurately separated by product surface.
title.zh: 同一供应商系列，按产品入口准确区分。

description.en: Reasoning, agent execution, image generation, and prepared code capacity connect to different parts of Floatboat. Review those boundaries before assigning a task, particularly where an older configuration record does not establish the current default picker or drawing workflow.

question.en: Which OpenAI model paths are available or configured in Floatboat?
question.zh: Floatboat 的 OpenAI 模型有哪些使用入口和配置？

answer.en: The page includes Astra, GPT-Image-2, GPT-5.6 and Codex configuration records, plus GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, and GPT-6.1 Sol now named on the pricing page. Their access status is shown separately.
answer.zh: 本页包含 Astra、GPT-Image-2、GPT-5.6 与 Codex 配置记录，以及价格页新增的 GPT-6 Sol、GPT-6 Luna 和 GPT-6.1 Sol，并分别标注接入状态。

question.en: What work is GPT-6 Astra intended for?
question.zh: GPT-6 Astra 适合什么工作？

answer.en: Astra is the live OpenAI option for flagship reasoning, complex instruction following, architecture decisions, and deep Agent orchestration.
answer.zh: Astra 是已上线的 OpenAI 旗舰推理选项，适合复杂指令遵从、架构决策与深度 Agent 编排。

question.en: Why is GPT Image 2 listed with text models?
question.zh: 为什么 GPT Image 2 与文本模型列在一起？

answer.en: It represents a different output lane—image generation—within the same broader workflow and project context.
answer.zh: 它代表同一完整工作流与项目上下文中的另一条输出路径：图像生成。

answer.en: GPT-Image-2 is positioned for high-quality image generation, illustrations, cover artwork, and other visual deliverables.
answer.zh: GPT-Image-2 面向高质量图片生成、插画、封面图以及其他视觉交付物。

question.en: What are GPT-5.3 Codex and Codex Spark for?
question.zh: GPT-5.3 Codex 与 Codex Spark 有什么用途？

answer.en: They are code-specialized evaluation profiles with configured 400K and 128K capacity, respectively.
answer.zh: 它们属于代码专用评测画像，分别配置了 400K 与 128K 容量。

question.en: Should a coding task and an image brief use the same OpenAI entry?
question.zh: 编程任务和图片任务应该使用同一个 OpenAI 入口吗？

answer.en: Choose by the required output and the entry supported in Floatboat. Repository work needs code execution and review context; image work needs a visual brief and an image-capable path. A shared provider name does not make these interfaces interchangeable.
answer.zh: 应根据输出类型和 Floatboat 中已支持的入口选择。代码库工作需要执行与审阅背景，图片任务需要视觉要求及图像生成入口；同属一家提供方，并不代表接口可以互换。

question.en: Are GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, and GPT-6.1 Sol listed by Floatboat?
question.zh: Floatboat 已列出 GPT-6 Sol、Luna 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 吗？

answer.en: Yes. All three names appear on the official pricing page checked on November 2, 2026. This confirms public listing, not the exact runtime IDs, plan eligibility, or exposure in every client.
answer.zh: 是的。2026 年 11 月 2 日核对的官方价格页已展示这三个名称。这能确认公开列出，不能据此确认准确运行时 ID、套餐资格或所有客户端都已开放。

title.en: Pick Astra for reasoning or GPT-Image-2 for visuals
title.zh: 推理选 Astra，画图用 GPT-Image-2

description.en: Use GPT-6 Astra in chat for reasoning and GPT-Image-2 through the image Combo for visuals; other versions have separate records and public listings; check the current menu before choosing one.
